visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white crop-top t-shirt, stands in a dimly lit room with blue and purple ambient lighting. She holds a black smartphone in her hands, looking at the screen with a hesitant and slightly anxious facial expression. (2) A close-up shot of the smartphone screen displays an incoming call labeled 'mobile' with options to decline or accept. The woman's thumb hovers over the screen but does not touch it. (3) The camera returns to a medium shot of the woman, who continues to watch the phone screen with a patient but awkward expression as it continues to ring. (4) The woman looks upward with a deep exhale and a small smile of relief, indicating the call has ended or gone to voicemail. (5) Now sitting on a dark couch, she is seen typing quickly on her phone with both thumbs, her eyes focused on the screen. (6) A close-up perspective shows her hands holding the phone as she presumably sends a text message. (7) She puts on a pair of black rectangular sunglasses and begins to perform a rhythmic, stylized dance move, pointing her fingers toward the camera with an energetic and playful demeanor. (8) She continues to dance, swaying her hips and making rhythmic hand gestures while standing in front of a shelf filled with small objects. (9) The woman appears in a different outfit configuration, now wearing a light blue baseball cap along with the sunglasses, as she points to her phone and continues the rhythmic dance sequence. (10) She performs a final celebratory dance move, looking directly at the camera with a confident and happy expression, swaying her body to the beat.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a mid-tempo electronic pop beat featuring a prominent kick drum and synthetic bass. A female vocal enters immediately, singing 'every time you call' with a rhythmic, melodic delivery. (2) As the lyrics describe watching the phone ring, the beat maintains a steady pulse. A faint electronic chime sound, mimicking a phone's incoming call tone, is layered subtly into the background. (3) The vocal performance becomes slightly more conversational but stays in time with the music. The pitch variability increases during the transition to the next phase. (4) A sharp, high-pitched vocal sound 'WHAT' serves as a transition marker. The music swells slightly in energy. (5) The main hook 'We saved ourselves a phone call' repeats with a highly rhythmic and percussive vocal delivery, perfectly synchronized with the strong beat of the electronic drums. (6) The track continues with the same high-energy arrangement until a hard cut at the end of the video, maintaining a consistent professional studio mix quality throughout.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous relatable meme about introverts (specifically 'I' types in MBTI) who feel anxious when receiving phone calls and prefer to wait for the call to end so they can text back instead. It uses a rhythmic song and dance to celebrate the successful avoidance of a voice conversation.
